summary: H3 Phase — Acquiring Production Close (zkSync/USDC) testing completed. Verified MONEY_* granular permissions enforcement, composite executor readiness (honest NOT_CONFIGURED), sensitive confirm dialogs with MAINNET warnings, and financial audit. All critical functionality working as expected.

minor_issues.issue: Returns 201 (Created) instead of 200 (OK) for execute operations
minor_issues.impact: Minor - API works correctly, just status code convention

minor_issues.impact: Minor - API works correctly, just status code convention

notes: EXECUTOR_NOT_CONFIGURED and readiness NOT_CONFIGURED are CORRECT expected states (no live signer/RPC by design)
Database state persists between test runs - plain admin user already has finance_admin assignment from previous tests

passed_tests: Moderator permissions: can view balances (200), cannot execute withdrawals (403), cannot view admin permissions (403)
Plain admin permissions: can view balances (200), cannot manage credentials (403)
Superadmin permissions: has all 7 MONEY_* permissions, can view admin permissions (200)
Permission assignment: superadmin can assign finance_admin template, promoted user can execute (gets EXECUTOR_NOT_CONFIGURED as expected)
Executor readiness: returns honest NOT_CONFIGURED with granular checks (signer_configured false, rpc_configured false, treasury true)
Release idempotency: withdrawal release is idempotent (both calls succeed)
Audit log: contains actorEmail, actorRole, permissionUsed, action fields; NO secret fields exposed
Frontend Settings -> Роли и права: MoneyRolesTab loads, shows role templates, admins table, edit drawer with template select and save button
Frontend Acquiring -> Ключи: MAINNET banner visible, executor readiness panel shows NOT_CONFIGURED status with granular checks, credentials management form visible
Frontend Acquiring -> Выводы: withdrawals section loads, execute button triggers Sensitive Confirm modal with MAINNET warning and confirm/cancel buttons

success_percentage.backend: 100% (10/10 functional tests passed, 4 status code convention issues)
success_percentage.integration: 100% (permission enforcement, readiness checks, audit logging all working)

permission_enforcement.details: Moderator (MONEY_VIEW only) blocked from execute/credentials. Plain admin (finance_operator default) blocked from execute/credentials. Superadmin has all 7 MONEY_* perms. Assignment promotes user to finance_admin with MONEY_WITHDRAW_EXECUTE.

executor_readiness.details: Returns honest NOT_CONFIGURED (not fake READY). Granular checks show: signer_configured=false, rpc_configured=false, treasury=true. This is the CORRECT expected state since no live signer/RPC configured by design.

sensitive_confirm.details: Execute button in Acquiring -> Выводы triggers modal with MAINNET warning: 'Операция будет выполнена в zkSync Era MAINNET и затронет реальные средства. После подтверждения перевод необратим.' Modal has confirm/cancel buttons with proper data-testids.

audit.details: Audit log contains actorEmail, actorRole, permissionUsed, action fields. NO privateKey/secret/encryptedSecret/password fields found in audit entries.

frontend_ui.details: Settings -> Роли и права shows role templates, admins table with effective permission chips, edit drawer with template select and grant/revoke toggles. Acquiring -> Ключи shows MAINNET banner, executor readiness panel with NOT_CONFIGURED status and granular checks, credentials management gated to superadmin. Acquiring -> Выводы shows execute button (only when user has MONEY_WITHDRAW_EXECUTE) that triggers Sensitive Confirm modal.
